title: Flatness of the polynomial-append tensor fibre
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $\Lambda$ a Noetherian $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $q\subset\Lambda$ a prime, $t,e\geq0$, $x:\operatorname{Fin}(t)\to\Lambda$, and $z:\operatorname{Fin}(e)\to q$. Set $P_0=k[X_j]$, $P_1=k[X_j,Y_i]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], $\varphi_0(X_j)=x_j$, $\varphi_1(X_j)=x_j$, $\varphi_1(Y_i)=z_i$, $p_a=\varphi_a^{-1}(q)$, $A_a=(P_a)_{p_a}$, and $L=\Lambda_q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Suppose the images of $z_i/1$ form a regular sequence in $L/p_0L$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Let $\iota:P_0\to P_1$ include the first variables. For every proof $h_c:p_0=\iota^{-1}(p_1)$, let $\alpha:A_0\to A_1$ be its induced local map and $\beta:A_1\to L$ the canonical evaluation localization map. Put $J=\alpha(\mathfrak m_{A_0})A_1$. The $A_1/J$-module $(A_1/J)\otimes_{A_1}L$, using $\beta$ for its $A_1$-structure, is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

proof.text: Modulo q every appended coordinate is zero. For a polynomial in the appended variables, evaluation modulo q is evaluation of its constant-in-Y coefficient modulo q. Hence p₁=p₀P₁+(Y_i). Localizing the first coefficients away from p₀ and reducing modulo p₀ gives κ(p₀)[Y_i], with contracted prime exactly the origin ideal (Y_i). The quotient and localization universal properties identify C=A₁/J with the localization at this ideal, carrying variable classes to origin parameters.

By the polynomial-origin theorem C is regular local, has dimension e, and its maximal ideal is generated by the e variable classes. Form S=L/p₀L. The ideal p₀L lies in the maximal ideal of L, since it is the extension of a contraction of q. Hence S is nonzero and local; it is Noetherian by quotient stability and localization Noetherianity. Compatibility of localized maps induces a local map C→S.

The variable parameters map to the assumed regular sequence in S. Apply flatness over a regular local source, Tag 07DY, to C→S and these e parameters. It makes S flat over C. This includes e=0: C is the residue field and its parameter list is empty.

The extended ideal JL equals p₀L because the localized first-coordinate map is β∘α. The quotient-tensor equivalence (A₁/J)⊗[A₁]L≃L/JL≃S is linear over C for the induced quotient action. Transport the C-flatness of S across this equivalence, proving the asserted tensor-fibre flatness. No flatness over A₀, generation, or regular locality of S is needed.

theorem flat_tensor_fibre_polynomial_append_of_regular_sequence
    (k : Type u) (Λ : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ]
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ] (q : Ideal Λ) [q.IsPrime]
    (t e : ℕ) (xs : Fin t → Λ) (zs : Fin e → Λ)
    (hzq : ∀ i, zs i ∈ q)
    (hseq : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Localization.AtPrime q ⧸
      (q.comap (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) xs).toRingHom).map
        ((algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q)).comp
          (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) xs).toRingHom))
      (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin e ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk
        ((q.comap (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) xs).toRingHom).map
          ((algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q)).comp
            (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) xs).toRingHom))
        (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q) (zs i))))) :
    let φ₀ : MvPolynomial (Fin t) k →ₐ[k] Λ := MvPolynomial.aeval xs
    let φ₁ : MvPolynomial (Fin (t + e)) k →ₐ[k] Λ :=
      MvPolynomial.aeval (Fin.addCases xs zs)
    let ι : MvPolynomial (Fin t) k →+* MvPolynomial (Fin (t + e)) k :=
      (MvPolynomial.rename (Fin.castAdd e)).toRingHom
    let p₀ := q.comap φ₀.toRingHom
    let p₁ := q.comap φ₁.toRingHom
    ∀ hc : p₀ = p₁.comap ι,
      let α := Localization.localRingHom p₀ p₁ ι hc
      let β := Localization.localRingHom p₁ q φ₁.toRingHom rfl
      letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p₀) (Localization.AtPrime p₁) := α.toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p₁) (Localization.AtPrime q) := β.toAlgebra
      let J := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p₀)).map α
      Module.Flat (Localization.AtPrime p₁ ⧸ J)
        ((Localization.AtPrime p₁ ⧸ J) ⊗[Localization.AtPrime p₁]
          Localization.AtPrime q)
